title: stabilize(slo-enforcer): add hysteresis and exponential backoff to reduce regional failover thrashing (hotfix)
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: under sustained bursty traffic we observed the SLO enforcer oscillating open/close of circuit-breakers which in turn triggered regional failover thrashing and increased error rates for customers. This hotfix introduces hysteresis and an exponential backoff policy to the SLO enforcer/circuit-breaker state machine, plus a short cooldown window for regional failover decisions to prevent repeated cross-region migrations. Changes are behind a feature-flag (slo_enforcer_hysteresis=true) and default-enabled for production clusters. High-level changes: - Add smoothing window for error-rate and latency signals (smoothed_error_rate, smoothed_p95) - Add minimum-open-duration and exponential backoff for CB reopen attempts - Add regional-failover cooldown and jitter to avoid synchronized retries across nodes - Expose new metrics (slo_enforcer.cb_open_count, slo_enforcer.backoff_state, slo_enforcer.region_failover_cooldown) - Add integration test that reproduces the thrashing pattern and asserts stabilization - Add config knobs with conservative defaults; documented in configs/defaults.yaml Rollout plan: feature-flag gated; progressive rollout to Dedicated clusters with monitoring dashboards and alerts enabled. Checklist: - [x] Implement hysteresis and backoff logic - [x] Add unit tests for state transitions - [x] Add integration test emulating bursty failures - [x] Update defaults/config and docs - [x] Run CI and flake-fix failing tests - [x] Monitoring dashboards added and alert thresholds described in PR notes Related work: ENG-2345 (post-incident mitigation), SRE-987 (regional failover runbook).

release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer to prevent regional failover thrashing. Adds hysteresis smoothing, CB exponential backoff, and a regional failover cooldown. Default-enabled behind feature flag. See ENG-2345 and SRE-987 for context.
notes_for_ops: After deploy monitor slo_enforcer.backoff_state and slo_enforcer.region_failover_cooldown metrics. If you observe persistent degraded throughput, temporarily disable slo_enforcer_hysteresis=false and contact SRE. Rollback steps included in docs/release_notes/pr-1106001.md.
